jobs.description:
As Global Head of Corporate Access, you will shape how Danske Bank’s Equities organisation connects clients with strategic opportunities across markets and locations. This is an opportunity to lead a global function that plays an important role in client engagement, commercial delivery and cross-functional collaboration across Equities.

What you will be doing

You will lead a geographically distributed Corporate Access team, working closely with colleagues across Equities and relevant stakeholders. The function sits at the heart of our client engagement model, and your work will shape how we connect institutional investors with the companies, subject matter experts and investment opportunities that matter to them. You will collaborate with senior stakeholders across business lines and geographies to align the Corporate Access offering with the commercial direction of Equities. In this role, you will have the ultimate ownership over large investor event such as seminars, as we as global thematic investor trips.

Your responsibilities:

• Define and execute the global Corporate Access strategy across relevant Equities locations.

• Lead and develop a distributed team, setting clear performance standards and accountability.

• Balance global priorities with local market requirements to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery.

• Build and maintain senior relationships across Equities and other relevant business areas.

• Identify opportunities to expand service capabilities and improve value for institutional investors and corporate clients.

• Establish governance frameworks, performance measures and operational standards globally.

• Drive process improvements and digitalisation initiatives across locations.

About you

• Strong understanding of institutional financial markets, corporate access services and client engagement models.

• Experience leading teams in an international, matrix-based organisation.

• Strategic and commercial judgement with the ability to translate priorities into delivery.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills.

• Experience with organisational development, transformation and continuous improvement.

• Ability to balance global priorities with local market requirements.

If you also bring experience from capital markets across relevant European markets, that would be a welcome addition to the team.

What we offer you

This role offers genuine scope to shape a global function within a bank that takes its Markets ambitions seriously. You will work in a hybrid model, typically spending three to four days a week in the office alongside your colleagues. We are committed to your continued development, and you will have access to learning opportunities and a collaborative environment where different perspectives are genuinely valued.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this role resonates with you, we would be glad to hear from you. Please reach out to hiring manager Asbjørn Nicholas Mørk at asb@danskebank.dk with any questions related to the role.

Last day to apply is 11th of December.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible as the position may be filled before the application deadline.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About the job

Do you want to make investing accessible to everyone, and be the driving force behind how a global bank achieves this? We are looking for a Head of Accessibility to lead accessibility across Saxo, from strategy and regulation to the screens our clients use every day.

This is a new role with a real mandate, visibility and impact. In this role, you will shape how Saxo approaches accessibility across every market we serve, work with senior leaders across the bank, and help make investing more inclusive for clients around the world. You will have the overall ownership of accessibility within Saxo.

The role is placed in our Platforms & AI (Journey 2) area within Saxo. In Journey 2, we build and develop Saxo's online trading and investing platforms. In this role you will report directly to the Head of Platform Management.

We offer a competitive salary package and have a hybrid working model from our headquarters in Hellerup.

Responsibilities

You'll be responsible for ensuring that Saxo meets accessibility requirements in the EU, Switzerland, the UK, Singapore, MENA and Japan. You will ensure this by working closely with our Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams. Furthermore, you will:

• 
Establish Saxo's accessibility governance framework within your first six months, including policy, standards, decision forums and controls

• 
Translate regulations in each market into clear requirements for the business

• 
Build and run a reporting framework that shows exactly where Saxo stands

• 
Create and own the roadmap, with clear dates for when compliance will be achieved

• 
Help teams build accessibility in from the start, through training, standards and tooling

• 
Get involved in design reviews to testing with assistive technologies

Your profile

• 
Several years of experience working with digital accessibility, including WCAG, EN 301 549 and assistive technologies

• 
Experience from the financial sector ideally with regulatory compliance or regulatory change

• 
Experience working with regulation requirements across several markets and an IAAP certification is a plus

• 
Strong stakeholder manager skills

• 
Ability to set up governance that works in practice

• 
Strong delivery mindset and a track record of landing complex, cross-organisational initiatives

• 
Hands-on and pragmatic approach

• 
Fluent in English

Apply via the link with your CV and a few lines about an accessibility or compliance initiative you've led and what it achieved. We review applications on an ongoing basis. For questions about the role, contact Casper Blücher Brun, Head of Platform Management, at cabr@saxobank.com.

We're looking forward to receiving your application.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

Some of the most critical applications in Danish banking run on technology that predates modern engineering practices. In the Reduce Legacy Tribe, you will help change that — applying AI, automation and thoughtful architecture to make modernisation faster, safer and repeatable. This is engineering work with real consequences, and you will see the results.

What you will be doing

You will join a collaborative squad working across teams to modernise business-critical web applications serving advisors, business customers and private customers. This is a practical software architecture role, not an Enterprise Architecture position.

You will analyse codebases, design migration patterns and develop reusable tooling with engineers, translating technical understanding into architecture decisions that guide day-to-day work. Working closely with development and delivery teams, you will shape solutions, discuss trade-offs and resolve implementation questions to make migration approaches workable.

Development teams retain ownership of implementation and delivery; your role is to help them turn complex modernisation challenges into practical solutions.

More specifically, you will:

• Analyse legacy code, dependencies and business flows to choose realistic migration strategies

• Design gradual replacements and rebuild where direct migration would carry complexity forward

• Develop reusable migration patterns, transition designs and developer tooling with teams

• Explore AI agents for analysis, component generation, testing and migration verification

• Reduce lead time through automated quality checks and safer, smaller deployments

About you

• Practical software engineering background, for example as a software architect, lead engineer or senior software engineer

• Strong understanding of end-to-end application design, including frontends, APIs, security, testing and observability

• Ability to read and understand an existing codebase and assess when to migrate, simplify or rebuild

• Clear communicator who can summarise complex topics and discuss trade-offs with engineers

• Understanding of AI-assisted development: how to guide agents, assess generated code and validate results

Experience with legacy modernisation, reusable migration tooling or our stack (React, .NET BFF services, Kubernetes, mainframe integration and GitHub Actions) is a plus. Comparable technologies are equally relevant, and we value the perspective you bring from different environments.

What we offer you

You will work primarily from our Aarhus or Copenhagen office, with the flexibility to work from home up to two days per week. You will tackle difficult engineering problems with visible results on applications used by thousands of customers, working alongside engineers who are genuinely curious about what AI can do for modernisation.

There is real room to grow your architectural thinking and broaden your experience with emerging development practices.

Are you ready for the next step?

If you are ready to take on complex engineering challenges and help shape the path forward for critical banking applications, we would be glad to hear from you. Reach out to hiring manager Ole Bang Fredsø Weigelt at owei@danskebank.dk if you have any questions.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 1 December 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Fixed income markets move fast, and clear, well-grounded analysis makes a real difference to the decisions clients and colleagues rely on every day. As a Fixed Income Strategist in our Fixed Income and FX Research team in Copenhagen, you will help shape the views we share with corporate and institutional clients across Europe. This is a role for someone with genuine curiosity and a commercial mindset.

What you will be doing

You will be part of a collaborative research team that works closely with Macro Research colleagues and strategists across our hubs. The team produces analysis that feeds directly into client decisions, and you will be a close sparring partner for both corporate and institutional clients. The atmosphere is open and collegial, with a shared commitment to rigorous, well-communicated research.

More specifically, you will:

• Produce interest rate forecasts and develop well-reasoned trading ideas

• Provide hedging recommendations to corporate and institutional clients

• Contribute to daily commentary on market developments and trends

• Represent our market views in client meetings and media appearances

• Collaborate with Macro Research and strategists across our hubs

About you

• Solid macroeconomic background with knowledge of EUR markets and ECB policy

• Experience producing fixed income research or interest rate analysis

• Strong communicator, able to tailor messages to different audiences

• Comfortable working independently and contributing within a team

• Analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations

If you also have experience with FX research or broader cross-asset analysis, that is a welcome addition. We value curiosity and a genuine interest in markets as much as formal credentials.

What we offer you

You will join a team that takes research seriously and values open discussion. We work in a hybrid model with three to four days per week in our Copenhagen office, giving you the benefits of in-person collaboration alongside flexibility. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills across asset classes, learn from experienced colleagues, and grow your profile both internally and externally.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right move for you, we would be glad to hear from you. Feel free to reach out to hiring manager Filip Andersson at filip.andersson@danskebank.se if you have any questions before applying.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Danske Bank

København K, 1300 København K Besøg hjemmeside

Filip Andersson filip.andersson@danskebank.se

jobs.occupation: Senior IT Specialist - Digital Transformation - Viby
jobs.description:
**Do you have the AI insight and business acumen to determine which technologies will create the greatest value for Arla in the years ahead?

**This is a unique opportunity to lead the AI agenda, driving the transformation from experimentation to scaled adoption of AI, Copilot, and intelligent automation across the business.

_“In this role you will influence the future of how more than 20,000 colleagues will benefit from emerging technologies across Arla. Your work will help identify the use cases that bring value, and the governance work you d__o will ensure a safe steer on the journey says Søren Bækgaard Hansen, Senior Director, CIO Office and Data Governance.

_**How You Will Make An Impact

**This role combines hands-on thought leadership with transformation execution. You will operate as a key driver in the CIO Office - shaping how AI is governed and embedded into everyday work.

As our new Senior IT Specialist you will take ownership of the AI governance framework and cross-functional collaboration model, ensuring that AI is used responsibly, effectively, and at scale across Arla. You will work closely with stakeholders across the business zones and functions, external partners, IT and senior leadership and act as a connector between strategy, governance, and delivery teams to drive tangible business value and outcomes.

**In this role, you will

**

• Lead the end-to-end AI governance agenda, including policies, standards, and controls across Agents, Copilot, and automation use cases

• Drive business transformation through AI by identifying opportunities, shaping PoCs and MVPs, defining value cases, and leading the transition from experiments to scaled solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes

• Enable adoption of AI by defining clear frameworks, practical guidelines, and reusable patterns for business and IT product teams

• Partner with senior leaders to translate emerging AI opportunities into strategic decisions, roadmaps, and practical actions that create business value

• Facilitate workshops and drive collaboration across platform teams, architects, product teams, and business functions

• Lead communication and storytelling that builds confidence, clarity, and momentum around AI at Arla

**What Will Make You Successful

**To succeed in this role, you bring solid experience driving AI, technology, or digital transformation initiatives in a complex organisation. Ideally, you have worked in a similar role within a large global company. Alternatively, you come from a consulting background where AI, emerging technologies, and business transformation have been a core part of your work.

• Strong understanding of governance, risk, and compliance, ideally in the context of AI or data

• Proven ability to drive adoption and influence without formal authority across multiple teams

• Solid stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage both technical experts and senior business leaders

• A pragmatic mindset – able to translate strategy into initiatives that drives real business value, that can be actionable by our IT & Digital organisation

• Strong communicator with the ability to drive fact-based storytelling and engagement

• Solid understanding of business challenges and opportunities in a large internal cooperation ideally in a FMCG context

• Confident in building business cases that demonstrates tangible business value

**What do we offer?

**You will join the CIO Office at Arla at a moment where AI is becoming a core capability across the Arla business.

We offer a highly visible role where you will help shape Arla’s AI and Agentic AI adoption journey. You will be part of a collaborative and forward-looking environment where innovation and execution go hand in hand, with opportunities to work with leading partners and technologies. You will also join a culture focused on learning, trust, and making a real impact, while helping define how AI creates value across one of the world’s leading dairy companies.

**Application & contact

**If you want to seize this exciting opportunity, please apply as soon as possible. For additional information, please contact Søren Bækgaard Hansen (sorha@arlafoods.com).

**Shape the Future of Dairy

**Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Ref.: 109628

Do you want to help keep the operational technology behind our wind assets reliable, resilient and ready for the future? We’re looking for an OT O&M Manager for Infrastructure to lead the services that enable secure connectivity, monitoring, control and operational data exchange across Business Area Wind.

OT infrastructure is the operational backbone of Business Area Wind. Every asset relies on it for secure connectivity, monitoring, control and the exchange of operational data.

We are looking for an OT O&M (Operation and Maintenance) Manager for Infrastructure within the OT team in Business Area Wind. This is an operational management role with end-to-end accountability for the performance, availability, reliability and continuous improvement of this business-critical service area.

You do not need to be the technical expert in every infrastructure domain. You do, however, need a strong understanding of OT environments and the ability to lead technical teams, challenge and support specialists, set priorities, make decisions and ensure that issues are driven through to resolution.

For this role, leadership, Accountability and Proactivity are as important as technical understanding. You will create the structure and momentum needed to deliver a reliable OT service.

The OT Infrastructure service area is responsible for the operation and maintenance of Operational Technology, including the hardware and software infrastructure that enables the flow of data between our enterprise network and our fleet of onshore and offshore wind farms. This includes central server infrastructure, such as asset data concentrators, data backup and restore solutions, and the supporting communication backbone, including Edge-to-Wide-Area connectivity solutions.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Qualifications

Your role

You will take end-to-end ownership of the OT Infrastructure service area and ensure that the hardware, software and connectivity supporting Business Area Wind’s assets remain reliable, resilient and available. You will set priorities for the service area, lead and develop technical teams, and establish clear governance for performance, costs, risks and lifecycle needs. A central part of the role is to shape the service strategy and roadmap while ensuring incidents, recurring problems and improvement needs are identified early and driven through to sustainable resolution. Working across OT, Operations, IT, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Procurement, projects and suppliers, you will coordinate the expertise needed to manage critical operational dependencies and keep the service fit for future business requirements.

Your Tasks And Responsibilities

• Take end-to-end accountability for the OT Infrastructure service area, including its performance, availability, reliability, cost and continuous improvement.

• Lead and develop the service area teams, setting clear priorities and expectations while empowering technical specialists to deliver within their areas of expertise.

• Drive operational performance, ensuring risks, incidents, recurring problems and improvement needs are proactively identified, prioritised and followed through to resolution.

• Own the service strategy and roadmap, including priorities, budget, resources, lifecycle needs and service development in line with Business Area Wind’s operational requirements.

• Provide effective operational governance, using service performance, risks, KPIs and technical input to make decisions and ensure clear accountability.

• Manage stakeholders and interfaces across Business Area Wind, bringing together OT, Operations, IT, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Procurement, projects and suppliers to solve problems and deliver results.

• Ensure effective management of critical incidents and operational risks, providing leadership and escalation when required and ensuring lessons learned result in sustainable improvements.

• Drive continuous improvement, challenging existing ways of working where necessary and ensuring the service remains reliable, resilient and fit for the future.

Your profile

You combine a good understanding of OT infrastructure and operations with leadership experience from complex operational settings. You are comfortable taking Accountability for a business-critical service without needing to be the deepest technical expert in every infrastructure domain. Instead, you create clarity, set priorities and empower specialists to deliver, while remaining able to challenge recommendations and make informed decisions. With Proactivity, Collaboration, Composure and a Solution-Oriented approach, you provide direction during incidents and periods of operational pressure, bring stakeholders together and ensure agreed actions are completed. You are motivated by improving reliability, resilience and ways of working over time.

Next To This You Bring

• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in operational management, O&M, IT/OT service management, infrastructure operations, engineering management or asset management, preferably within energy or another asset-intensive industry.

• Experience leading technical teams or services in a complex operational environment, with a track record of improving performance and driving issues through to resolution.

• A good understanding of OT infrastructure and operations, sufficient to lead technical specialists, understand risks and dependencies, challenge recommendations and make informed decisions.

• Strong service-management capabilities, including operational performance, incident and problem management, lifecycle planning, risk management and continuous improvement.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams, business functions, suppliers and management.

• A relevant degree in engineering, technology, business or a similar discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands - Kolding, Denmark

Additional Information

Our offer

Looking for a career with growth?

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can really find your element with us. We’ll also provide you with all the learning and development you need to expand your horizons.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths, whatever their background and experiences.

You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

More Information

For more information about the position, you are welcome to contact hiring manager Hasan Özdem, hasan.oezdem@vattenfall.de. For more information about the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact our recruiter Christian Pathuel, christian.pathuel@vattenfall.com

We welcome your application in English no later than 03.12.2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be a good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. Click here for further information.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfil within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, Validata.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Where there’s you, there’s a way.

Joining us, your benefits would include:

If this all sounds great and this could be the role for you, let us know and apply today.

At Monsoon Accessorize we don’t focus only on what we do, we also care about how we do it. Our values and the way we behave are important to us.

We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce and an environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, enabling all of our employees to thrive and achieve their full potential.

This is a permanent, full-time position. Send us your application and CV today!

jobs.occupation: Postdoc of Environmental Economics and Management
jobs.description:
The position is tied to three interdisciplinary European projects, MOSAIC, INTERCEDE and the upcoming Wild2050 project, which combine environmental valuation, environmental policy, and land use planning. The position is open from March 1st, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter, and it is a two-year position.

  In MOSAIC, the role will be primarily one of coordination: the postdoc will liaise with the leads of project’s case studies and synthesise results across cases, with a focus on the uptake of land use policy instruments and comparison of methods. This requires strong communication, organizational skills, and the ability to work independently with multiple international research partners. In INTERCEDE, the work will involve analyses around the demand for forest ecosystem services, and in Wild2050 how demand for biodiversity conservation may change towards 2050. Across the projects, this research will require experience with quantitative methods including monetary and non-monetary valuation as well as cross-country analysis all in an interdisciplinary setting.

  The postdoc’s duties will include research in environmental economics and management, as well as contributing to project reporting. The position may also include teaching or other duties.

  Further information on the Department is linked at https://www.ku.dk/ifro/en. Inquiries about the position can be made to Professor Jette Bredahl Jacobsen jbj@ifro.ku.dk or by phone +45 35 33 17 46.

  Physical presence at IFRO is considered as a natural part of being an employee to contribute to a welcoming, socially pleasant, creative and innovative work environment. IFRO offers possibility for flexibility and working from home, but an employee is expected to regularly be present physically at IFRO.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Terms of employment

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

  Please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent) 	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers   The deadline for applications is 14 December 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

   After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held on January 26, 2027.

**We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!

**_As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.

_**The Role

**It's an exciting time to join our B2B Sales team in Copenhagen as an Junior Account Executive, where you can directly see the impact of your work on the front line of the company's growth. In this role, you will be responsible for selling our business solutions to both new and existing users of the EasyPark app. You will actively sell, negotiate, and quote our Corporate SaaS solution, while providing proactive follow-up, product information, and overall account support via the telephone. This position reports to a supportive and coaching leadership team within the B2B Sales function, offering a clear development career plan and structured training programs to help you succeed. You will collaborate closely with internal team members and key stakeholders to deliver an exceptional customer experience, driving urban mobility forward in a fast-paced environment.

**How To Make An Impact

**

• Actively sell, negotiate, and quote EasyPark B2B solutions, providing proactive follow-up, product information, and overall account support via the telephone.

• Establish and nurture strong relationships with customers to drive sales and increase brand loyalty.

• Manage daily call activity through an effective, well-planned sales targeting approach, consistently meeting all KPIs based on defined expectations.

• Maintain and update the CRM system diligently to ensure high data quality and accurate reporting.

• Take commercial responsibility for customer deals, ensuring the delivery of qualitative sales and true value in every interaction.How to make an impact

**About You

**You are a positive, self-motivated professional with a collaborative, win-win mindset who thrives in a team-oriented environment. You enjoy sharing a good laugh and celebrating success with your colleagues, while bringing an entrepreneurial spirit and a passion for continuous improvement. You possess excellent active listening skills, allowing you to quickly adapt during interactions and shift focus from a standard pitch to genuinely understanding a customer’s unique situation and needs. You are resilient, determined, and an innovative thinker who never settles for "good enough," always striving to develop your skills and overcome challenges to deliver great results.

**Your background

**

• Previous experience in sales, with a strong preference for B2B phone sales experience.

• Proven determination to strive for and consistently exceed goals and performance targets.

• Collaborative team player who is also highly self-motivated and comfortable working independently.

• Efficient communicator with strong active listening, verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

jobs.description:
If you’re energised by turning complex project data into AI-powered insights and you thrive on taking ideas from prototype to production, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for two Senior Data Scientists with dedicated expertise in AI technologies to join our team in Project Systems supporting our Project Management area.

As a team, we are working on the data, systems and digital tools that support our customer pharma projects, all the way from design to handover of project documentation to the client. Your contribution will be important in turning that data into structure, insights and AI solutions that make our project execution smarter and more efficient.

You will work across the full AI lifecycle, from data preparation and machine learning to generative AI, large language models (LLMs) and AI agents, and help shape how NNE uses AI responsibly in a regulated pharma environment. This is your chance to become our go-to expert in AI and make a significant impact on the future of AI at NNE.

How you might spend your days

As a Senior Data Scientist, you’ll be:

• 
Designing and deploying problem-solving AI and machine-learning solutions, from predictive models to generative AI and agent-based applications

• 
Analyzing and structuring data across the project lifecycle, and helping design AI solutions together with business users

• 
Driving AI initiatives from proof of concept (PoC) to production-ready solutions in collaboration with colleagues from Project Management and Global IT

• 
Acting as the link between business needs and IT data engineers, speaking both the IT and the business “language”

• 
Presenting trends, patterns and predictions to management and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and actionable way

• 
Driving responsible AI adoption by mentoring colleagues, setting best practices for MLOps and AI governance, and keeping us up to date with the latest AI advancements.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• 
Curious and innovative, with a genuine interest in technology and in putting new knowledge to use

• 
Pragmatic and solution-oriented, combining strong analytical skills with technical understanding

• 
Experienced in AI-assisted development with e.g Claude Code or Microsoft Copilot Studio.

• 
A clear communicator who can explain complex AI topics to colleagues, clients and management

• 
Comfortable working independently as well as collaborating with many stakeholders across disciplines and cultures

• 
Excited to share your knowledge, help others grow and build on the NNE culture of innovation

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• 
You have a master’s degree or PhD in data science, computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering or a related field

• 
You have 5–8 years of hands-on experience in data science, including taking machine-learning models from prototype to production

• 
You have strong programming skills in Python and SQL, and experience with ML frameworks such as scikit-learn or PyTorch

• 
You have practical experience with generative AI, such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and Microsoft Copilot, Claude Code or Azure AI services

• 
You are fluent in written and spoken English, and Danish language skills are a plus.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

• Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities keeping momentum when it matters most.

• Celebrate wins and learn fast from misses alongside an ambitious, diverse team.

• Push boundaries with courage and resilience while staying true to our DNA.

**A Brief Overview Of Our Tech Stack

**

• PHP/Laravel monolith

• Kotlin services with Micronaut and Exposed

• Dart/Flutter (incl. Flutter Web) for apps

• Typescript/React (+Next.js) for web apps and rapid prototyping

• Observability via Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch/Kibana

• AWS + Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD for deployments

What We’re Looking For

• Junior ready for the next jump or mid-level backend experience: You have experience building scalable backend systems.

• Tech Stack: You have worked in Kotlin (Micronaut) and PHP (Laravel), or have experience in one with the ability to quickly master the other in a mixed environment.

• Clear & pragmatic communicator who builds alignment fast.

• Authentic team player with empathy, openness, and ownership.

• Comfortable with AI-powered tools to accelerate your work (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.), with the willingness to learn more.

_If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway - we care about potential, not perfection.

_**AI Competency

**You’ll be expected to work with AI-powered tools. Some we use:

• GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

_We don’t expect mastery of all, but we expect comfort with learning, experimenting, and adopting AI responsibly.

_Why Monta

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• Becoming number one is not easy — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.

jobs.occupation: Personal Care Assistant wanted for a woman with a brain injury in Rødovre – 1-2 days per week
jobs.description:
We are looking for a compassionate, reliable, and caring Personal Care Assistant to support a woman who recently returned home after rehabilitation.

She lives in a house in Rødovre with her husband and their two children. Following a cerebral hemorrhage, she has an acquired brain injury and paralysis on one side of her body. She has lost her ability to speak but understands English. Applicants must be able to speak English.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Providing personal care and daily support

• Assisting with transfers and everyday routines

• Being a calm, reassuring, and caring presence

Working hours:

• 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM

• 1-2 shifts per week

• Shifts alternate between Wednesdays and Fridays

• We work on a 6-week rotation, with both Wednesday and Friday shifts every sixth week

We offer:

• Immediate start

• A meaningful role where you can make a real difference

• The opportunity to work with a wonderful and kind family

• Support and introduction from an experienced colleague who previously worked with the woman and knows both her and the family very well

If interested please contact area manager: Julie Ngo, jun@oliviadanmark or at +45 61 10 04 64

Do you want to help ensure reliable documentation for electrical infrastructure projects? Can you bring structure to complex documentation flows and secure complete project records? And do you have at least five years of experience in document control? Then join COWI as our new Document Controller.

**Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**We are looking for a Document Controller to join COWI and support our customer's electrical infrastructure projects. You will help ensure that both internal project documentation and supplier documentation are collected, organised and securely archived. Following an introduction to the relevant processes, methods and systems, you will work with minimal supervision to ensure complete project documentation through to final handover and project closure.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Set up archiving structures in the customer's electronic document and records management system and clarify which documentation must be collected and retained.

• Collect and secure internal project documentation from customer-managed SharePoint sites, as well as photographic documentation and other project records.

• Collect and secure supplier documentation, including collaborating with the customer's IT team on developing APIs or automation tools where needed.

• Ensure that final as-built documentation is complete, that projects comply with the customer's archiving guidelines, and that sites and platforms are closed down at project completion.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

• At least five years of experience in document control.

• Experience with electronic document management (EDM) systems, an aptitude for IT and a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office

• Experience managing electronic workflows and as-built documentation.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English.

• A structured and thorough approach, enjoyment of process-oriented tasks, and a service-minded, collaborative and practical attitude. You are motivated and engaged, with a focus on helping projects succeed

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer - Revenue Enablement Group
jobs.description:
Veo is a global leader in AI-based sports camera technology. Our innovative, fully automatic camera solution enables sports teams to record matches and training sessions without a camera operator. We’re democratizing the world of sports by granting video analysis for teams on all levels—a privilege that used to be only for the few. More than 40,000 clubs in 90+ countries record their games every week.

But what truly sets us apart? Our people. We’re a diverse group of innovative thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who believe in delivering an incredible product—and having fun while doing it.

**The Opportunity

**Veo's Revenue Platform is the engine that drives the business. Each subscription, order, invoice, payment and shipment passes through the platform that our team built. We are looking for a senior engineer to help take it to the next level.

The team owns the core revenue engine that sits between Veo's products and the systems that run the business: billing, payments, CRM, ERP and fulfillment. Other teams use our APIs to sell, quote, bill and provision. Finance relies on us to get the numbers right.

The foundations are in place. The next chapter is about making the platform more robust, easier to build on, and ready for new markets, products and pricing models. You'll model subscription lifecycles, amendments, quotes, tax and payment flows. You'll make workflows stay correct when a third-party API fails halfway through an order. You'll also work closely with Finance, Sales and Product so the business logic in code matches how the business actually works.

**What You Will Do

**

• Evolve and scale backend services in Rust that process real revenue: orders, subscriptions, invoicing, payments and provisioning.

• Strengthen our Temporal workflows so they are reliable, idempotent and safe to change, through versioning and replay.

• Shape the Revenue Platform API into a clear, OpenAPI-first product that internal teams can adopt with confidence.

• Improve our integrations with billing, payment, CRM, ERP and logistics providers, and handle their failure modes properly.

• Turn ambiguous commercial requirements (pricing changes, new markets, new payment methods) into correct, well-documented business logic.

• Own what you ship in production: observability, alerting, incident response, and data migrations that touch thousands of customer accounts.

• Incorporate modern AI development tools into your workflow to iterate quickly and build thoughtful software solutions.

• Set technical direction for the platform's next phase, and raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews and testing.

**What You Could Bring

**

• 5+ years as a software engineer, with significant backend experience.

• Backend experience using Python, Rust, or another comparable language. Rust in production is ideal, but we'll also consider strong backend engineers who have built real things in Rust and want to go deeper.

• Experience in revenue-critical domains is a plus: billing, subscriptions, payments, e-commerce, or financial systems.

• Strong API design skills, and experience integrating with third-party APIs that don't always behave.

• Experience building distributed systems where correctness under failure matters.

• The judgement to make architectural calls and to improve a live system without stopping the business.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams. You've worked closely with product managers, designers, finance, data and commercial stakeholders, and you're comfortable bringing them along on technical trade-offs.

• A product-oriented mindset. You care about the outcome, not just the code. You ask why before how, and you treat the platform's API and its internal users with the same care as an external product.

• Curiosity about modern AI development tools and how they can support everyday engineering workflows.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to contribute meaningfully.
